name: smwgraphics-super-mario-rpg-legend-of-the-seven-stars-vista-hill
title: Super Mario RPG: Legend of the Seven Stars - Vista Hill
description:
Layer 3 Cloud Layer used in Vista Hill where Mario overlooks Bowser's Keep from afar. Highly recommend using one of the following patches to avoid having the background being cutoff:
edit1754's Sprite Status Bar, WhiteYoshiEgg's DKCR Styled Sprite Status Bar, Ladida's SMB3 and Minimalist Status Bars or (alternatively) Lui37's Remove Status Bar.

Update: Now includes the daytime palette used in the credits sequence.

Moderator's note: by setting Initial Y Position to 0B0 in the Layer 3 Settings to lower the background vertically, I managed to make it not get cutoff by the status bar. If you want to place it higher, then you can use one of the patches mentioned above to circumvent the cutoff issue.
